summary: The R7 assurance defect is resolved by an explicit historical erratum and actual MathML. All eight v5 pages were viewed. Heading, theorem, table, and six display-formula presentation improve, but inline multiplication asterisks are consumed as emphasis delimiters and need protection.
required_revisions: Protect inline multiplication expressions from Markdown emphasis parsing, including both small-L paragraphs; regenerate and inspect affected PDF pages and HTML source.

findings.disposition: Use protected inline source/math spans to preserve the intended notation.

revisions.action: Checked erratum, receipt, six mappings and generated MathML.
revisions.result: The earlier overstatement is explicitly corrected.

checks.scope: v5 repair and complete page inspection
checks.method: Verified snapshot, manuscript, manifest and all fourteen file hashes; viewed pages 1–8; inspected HTML and receipt source.
checks.observation: Six display mappings preserve mathematical content; table headers repeat across pages 6–7 without clipping. HTML supplies six annotated MathML elements and overflow-x:auto containment. Browser behavior, assistive technology and PDF tagging were not tested. Inline-emphasis parsing remains the identified repair.
